Context: Conditions to be fulfilled.-

- (vii) Once the Pro forma Promotion is given, the officer's pay will be fixed with reference to the pay in the Pay Band of his immediate junior in the cadre of his service and continue to draw the grade pay attached to the deputation post for the remaining period of deputation.
- (viii) Such officiating pay drawn in the higher post should not exceed the maximum of the pay scale in ex cadre post. If it exceeds, officer will be reverted to his cadre within six months.
